package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/artifact"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/record"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/choice"
)

func main() {
	input := flag.String("artifact", "", "fresh baseline artifact")
	output := flag.String("output", "", "separate publication root")
	mutation := flag.String("mutation", "site", "site or stdout")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*input, *output, *mutation); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(input, output, mutation string) (retErr error) {
	opened, err := artifact.OpenArtifact(input)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := opened.Close(); retErr == nil {
			retErr = err
		}
	}()
	manifest := opened.Manifest()
	payloads := []artifact.Payload{}
	for _, file := range manifest.Files {
		data, err := opened.ReadPayload(file.Path, uint64(file.Size))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		payloads = append(payloads, artifact.Payload{Path: file.Path, Mode: 0600, Data: data, SHA256: file.SHA256, Size: file.Size})
	}
	if mutation == "site" {
		if manifest.ChoiceProfile == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("site mutation requires complete choices")
		}
		metadata := &manifest.ChoiceProfile.Trace
		data, err := opened.ReadPayload(metadata.File, uint64(metadata.Bytes))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		digest, err := metadata.SHA256.Bytes()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		trace, err := choice.DecodeStoredTrace(choice.Profile, data, choice.TerminalMetadata{State: choice.TerminalComplete, Limit: uint64(metadata.Limit), Records: uint64(metadata.Records), SHA256: digest})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		found := false
		for index := range trace.Records {
			if trace.Records[index].Flags&choice.FlagDecision != 0 {
				trace.Records[index].Flags &^= choice.FlagSiteMissing
				trace.Records[index].SiteOffset++
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return fmt.Errorf("fixture contains no replay decision")
		}
		trace, err = choice.BuildTrace(trace.Records, choice.TerminalComplete)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target, err := manifest.Target.SHA256.Bytes()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		implementation, err := manifest.ChoiceProfile.ImplementationSHA256.Bytes()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		tape, err := choice.ProjectReplayPlan(trace, choice.ExecutionIdentity{TargetSHA256: target, ToolchainBuildKey: manifest.Toolchain.BuildKey, GOOS: "wasip1", GOARCH: "wasm", ImplementationSHA256: implementation})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		metadata.SHA256 = record.SHA256FromSum(trace.SHA256)
		metadata.TapeSHA256 = record.SHA256FromSum(tape.SHA256)
		for index := range payloads {
			if payloads[index].Path == metadata.File {
				payloads[index].Data = trace.Bytes
				payloads[index].SHA256 = metadata.SHA256
			}
		}
	} else if mutation == "stdout" {
		for index := range payloads {
			if payloads[index].Path == manifest.Streams.Stdout.File {
				if len(payloads[index].Data) == 0 {
					return fmt.Errorf("stdout mutation requires nonempty output")
				}
				payloads[index].Data[0] ^= 1
				payloads[index].SHA256 = record.HashBytes(payloads[index].Data)
				manifest.Streams.Stdout.FullSHA256 = payloads[index].SHA256
				manifest.Streams.Stdout.RetainedSHA256 = payloads[index].SHA256
			}
		}
	} else {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported mutation %q", mutation)
	}
	published, err := (artifact.Store{Root: output, Key: artifact.StoreKeyRecord}).PublishArtifact(artifact.Publication{Record: manifest, Payloads: payloads})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"artifact": published.Path, "record_hash": published.Manifest.RecordHash, "mutation": mutation})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Println(string(encoded))
	return nil
}
